chortle.oewn-00031656-v.tone: Gleeful and slightly comic - delight bubbling through restraint.

wail.oewn-00065796-v.reason: OEWN gloss 'cry weakly or softly' is the whimper synset and does not fit wail

asleep.oewn-00096726-s.tone: The gentlest euphemism - death softened into rest.

monstrous.oewn-00223219-s.tone: Ugliness that frightens - shape gone wrong enough to horrify.

unsightly.oewn-00224135-s.tone: Offends the eye - and lands harder on a person than on a thing.

lily-livered.oewn-00266180-s.tone: Dated, theatrical scorn - the pale liver standing in for a missing spine.

dastardly.oewn-00266631-s.tone: Cowardice joined to malice - the blow struck from safety.

fainthearted.oewn-00266855-s.tone: Lacking boldness - the mildest word in the family, closer to pity than contempt.

timid.oewn-00266855-s.tone: Soft censure - the courage is missing, but the word pities more than it blames.

pass.oewn-00359085-v.tone: Even shorter and softer than 'pass away' - the gentlest form of the euphemism.

dim.oewn-00442596-s.tone: Gently disparaging; British - slowness treated as a mild failing.

dumb.oewn-00442596-s.tone: Harsh and casual - intelligence dismissed in one flat syllable.

chubby.oewn-00989957-s.tone: Mild and affectionate - fullness framed as pleasing rather than faulted.

cordial.oewn-01078866-s.tone: Warmth actively given off - genial, easy friendliness that puts people at ease.

affable.oewn-01078866-s.tone: Easy, unforced warmth of manner - friendliness that costs its owner nothing.

companionate.oewn-01079430-s.tone: Technical and cool - it describes the fit, not the affection.

comradely.oewn-01079552-s.tone: Hearty warmth between equals - friendliness declared out loud rather than implied.

hail-fellow.oewn-01079552-s.tone: Heartiness offered to everyone alike - friendliness worn as a manner.

couthy.oewn-01079712-s.tone: A spelling of 'couthie', with the same Scots warmth.

cozy.oewn-01079833-s.tone: Of an atmosphere rather than a person - warmth kept at a small and informal scale.

echt.oewn-01119091-a.tone: Literary - it praises the real thing while advertising the speaker's taste.

authentic.oewn-01119377-s.tone: Carries the weight of proof - the genuine article, not the imitation.

veritable.oewn-01119377-s.tone: Formal certification that the thing is the real article - stiffer than 'genuine'.

dandy.oewn-01127641-s.tone: Old-fashioned cheer - approval with a quaint, breezy ring.

acceptable.oewn-01128566-s.tone: Clears the bar and no more - praise so measured it can read as disappointment.

atrocious.oewn-01130122-s.tone: Severe and formal - badness spoken of as if it were an outrage.

awful.oewn-01130122-s.tone: Strong, sweeping condemnation - emphasis rather than description.

deplorable.oewn-01130672-s.tone: Formal sorrow at a state of things - lamented rather than blamed.

affluent.oewn-02029380-s.tone: Formal and unruffled - wealth reported as a circumstance, not a boast.

poor.oewn-02030204-a.tone: The plain word for a lasting condition - factual, and heavy for being so plain.

broke.oewn-02030538-s.tone: Casual - out of money right now, a state rather than a condition.

purloin.oewn-02281711-v.tone: Deliberately grand for a small crime - the pomp is the joke.

shoplift.oewn-02282148-v.flag: charge lowered -2 to -1: note calls the word factual rather than condemning; note kept

rob.oewn-02326371-v.tone: The victim stands in the object - one robs a person, where one steals a thing.

steal.oewn-02326737-v.tone: The plain word - direct, and it names the wrong outright.

loot.oewn-02350284-v.reason: OEWN gloss 'take illegally; of intellectual property' does not fit loot

fall.oewn-02626293-v.tone: A soft, dignifying word for a death in the field - soldier or quarry, the fall sounds fated rather than inflicted.

choleric.oewn-00115732-s.tone: Judges the character, not the moment: anger as a person's built-in temper.

work-shy.oewn-00295445-s.tone: Accusing - unwillingness to work treated as a character fault, not a circumstance.

otiose.oewn-00295445-s.tone: Idleness stated with Latinate coolness - disinclination to effort, judged from a height.

leisured.oewn-00296101-s.tone: Idleness admired - because it is assumed to have been paid for.

passing.oewn-00313032-s.tone: The mildest in the family - the inattention is admitted but hardly blamed.

nice.oewn-00644482-s.tone: Praise so mild it can read as faint disappointment.

puff.oewn-00798965-v.tone: Bluster as sound - the speech is loud air, scorn without substance.

reproof.oewn-00825727-v.tone: The same quiet correction as the noun - the fault is named without heat.

troll.oewn-00829262-v.tone: Archaic and hearty - praise sung out in a full round voice.

glorify.oewn-00862284-v.tone: Praise raised toward worship - and it turns accusatory the moment the object does not deserve it.

gasconade.oewn-00884747-v.tone: A learned, ornamental word for showing off - the vocabulary preening along with the speaker.

kvetch.oewn-00909100-v.tone: Exasperated but half-affectionate - complaining treated as a known habit.

plain.oewn-00909100-v.tone: Archaic - the bare, unadorned verb for voicing discontent.

quetch.oewn-00909100-v.tone: A grumbling word - the complaint voiced as habitual discontent.

bighearted.oewn-01115129-s.tone: Entirely sincere - it praises the person, not the sum.

liberal.oewn-01115129-s.tone: Of portions and allowances, not politics - abundance framed as generosity.

giving.oewn-01115129-s.tone: Slightly therapeutic in register; it names a personality type rather than an act.

genteel.oewn-01954376-s.tone: Refinement praised, but primly - the word can carry a faintly pitying edge, as in 'shabby-genteel'.

polite.oewn-01954376-s.tone: Not courtesy but cultivation - the refinement a whole circle credits itself with.

couth.oewn-01954649-s.tone: Almost always a joke - refinement praised with one eyebrow raised.

niminy-piminy.oewn-01954782-s.tone: Pure contempt - the invented, mincing sound does the sneering.

get_a_load.oewn-02136242-v.tone: An invitation to look and react - the judgement falls on the thing seen, not on the looking.

bolshy.oewn-02335307-s.tone: Frames the refusal as insubordination rather than character - mutinous, not merely difficult.

edacious.oewn-00010745-s.tone: Too bookish to wound - the oddity of the word softens the greed into comedy.

rapacious.oewn-00010745-s.tone: The hunger is predatory - devouring as though by seizure.

piggish.oewn-00011346-s.tone: Greed and coarseness laid on with the farm animal - the comparison does the insulting.

porcine.oewn-00011346-s.tone: Formal and cold - the comparison to swine delivered clinically, which sharpens it.

glad.oewn-00363972-s.tone: Quieter than 'happy' - cheer showing on the surface of things.

beamish.oewn-00364111-s.tone: Storybook brightness - the smile is pure, quaint delight.

blithesome.oewn-00364371-s.tone: The archaic-sounding form - it carries a deliberate literary flavour.

lightsome.oewn-00364371-s.tone: Archaic in flavour - happiness carried as lightness.

blithe.oewn-00364371-s.tone: Sunny and unburdened - a lightness of spirit meant kindly.
blithe.oewn-00364371-s.flag: charge 0 to +1: neutrality rested on the imported heedless sense; this gloss is wholly warm

light-hearted.oewn-00364371-s.tone: The hyphenated spelling, identical in warmth.

dirty.oewn-00420808-a.tone: The plain word for soiling - direct, and mildly reproachful.

soiled.oewn-00420808-a.tone: Clinical and euphemistic - a softer word chosen to avoid 'dirty'.

draggled.oewn-00421806-s.tone: A form of 'bedraggled', with the same sympathy for whatever got dragged through the mud.

fouled.oewn-00421999-s.tone: The plainer form of 'befouled' - the same dirtying stated without relish.

grungy.oewn-00422169-s.tone: Informal and unimpressed - dirt that has been let settle in for good.

raunchy.oewn-00422169-s.tone: Dated - grime so thick it has worked into the thing itself.

begrimed.oewn-00422169-s.tone: Heavy, literary dirt - ingrained past any quick washing.

buggy.oewn-00422721-s.tone: Disgust with a squirm in it - not merely dirty but inhabited.

hardcore.oewn-00965214-s.tone: Loyalty at full strength - nothing held back and no way out.

leal.oewn-00965324-s.tone: Scottish and archaic - faithfulness with the ring of an old oath.

true-blue.oewn-00965665-s.tone: Loyalty proved and unswerving - steadfastness as identity.

mean.oewn-01116711-s.tone: Of the amount, not the giver - a sum small enough to read as an insult.

chintzy.oewn-01116856-s.tone: Stinginess with the embarrassment built in - the cheapness shows.

cheap.oewn-01116856-s.tone: Stinginess as a public embarrassment - the shame is the point.

near.oewn-01116967-s.tone: A euphemism - stinginess softened into mere 'closeness' with money.

skinny.oewn-01116967-s.tone: Stinginess as thinness - giving kept as lean as the frame.

closefisted.oewn-01117247-s.tone: The hand that will not open - refusal made physical.

hardfisted.oewn-01117247-s.tone: Harder than 'closefisted' by a shade - the fist has closed tighter.

inhumane.oewn-01265721-a.tone: Condemnation in an official voice - cruelty assessed rather than felt.

savage.oewn-01266123-s.tone: Brutality at full pitch - cruelty with restraint stripped away.

benign.oewn-01375700-s.tone: Mild kindness - gentler in force than 'benevolent', warmth without much heat.

humble.oewn-01899020-a.tone: Praise for modesty worn willingly - the opposite of arrogance, and credited for it.

humbled.oewn-01899370-s.tone: Brought down and knowing it - the word reports the defeat and expects it to be admitted.

low.oewn-01899370-s.tone: Status, not disposition - fallen in condition rather than in spirits.

modest.oewn-01899577-s.tone: Approving of a retiring manner - mildness as virtue, though the gloss lets it border on submissiveness.

egocentric.oewn-02105605-a.tone: The clinical-sounding member of the family - reads as diagnosis more than accusation.

self-loving.oewn-02105974-s.tone: The literal compound turned accusation - love pointed at the wrong object.

egotistical.oewn-02105974-s.tone: Flat contempt for self-importance - the inflation is visible to everyone but its owner.

tricky.oewn-00149346-s.tone: A warning - the skill is in deceiving you.

content.oewn-00591490-a.tone: The plainest form, and it can shade toward settling - satisfied because one has stopped asking.

magisterial.oewn-00791150-s.tone: Authority assumed rather than earned - the offence is in the presumption.

dominating.oewn-00791150-s.tone: Faults the manner more than the strength - self-assurance exercised as power nobody granted.

bullying.oewn-00791587-s.tone: Names harm rather than manner - the browbeating of others is the point.

deluxe.oewn-00853459-s.tone: A marketing word more than a compliment - it still sounds like packaging.

de_luxe.oewn-00853459-s.tone: The spaced spelling, slightly more formal than 'deluxe'.

fine.oewn-00853589-s.tone: In this sense, genuine praise - refinement noticed and credited.

high-toned.oewn-00853840-s.tone: Sneers at the elegance as put on - the height is affectation.

soignee.oewn-00854162-s.tone: Admiring: polish so complete the effort disappears.

unmerciful.oewn-01511081-a.tone: Mercy named only as the thing withheld - slightly more formal than 'merciless'.

bowelless.oewn-01511487-s.tone: Pitiless - ruthlessness with no mercy left in it.

cutthroat.oewn-01511487-s.tone: Ruthlessness named as a killer's - condemnation with half a boast inside it.

fierce.oewn-01511487-s.tone: No quarter given - ruthlessness the word does not soften.

ruthless.oewn-01511765-s.tone: The everyday word - it makes the absence of pity a settled character, not a lapse.

enduring.oewn-01740633-s.tone: Praise for the bearing - the wrongs are continual and the patience holds.

tolerant.oewn-01741132-s.tone: Endurance credited as a virtue - hardship borne without complaint.

artless.oewn-01956562-s.tone: Faults a lack of training or knowledge - mild, closer to pity than to scorn.

uncouth.oewn-01957020-s.tone: Harsher than 'rough-cut': the missing refinement read as offensive in itself.

coarse.oewn-01957020-s.tone: Rough-grained manners - it suggests a person left unfinished.

dear.oewn-02187588-s.tone: Earnestness at full warmth - a wish held close to the heart.

heartfelt.oewn-02187588-s.tone: Earnest and unadorned - it stakes the speaker's own sincerity on the feeling.

devout.oewn-02187588-s.tone: Earnestness with full weight behind it - a devout wish is meant, not merely said.

true.oewn-02187907-s.tone: Unfeigned rather than merely accurate - the feeling is as real as it looks.

heart-whole.oewn-02188116-s.tone: Nothing held back and nothing divided; slightly archaic.

whole-souled.oewn-02188116-s.tone: The most emphatic form - devotion offered with the whole self.

dewy-eyed.oewn-02279797-s.tone: Faintly mocking - the credulity is what is being pointed at.

round-eyed.oewn-02279797-s.tone: Slightly comic - the eyes wide with belief.

ingenuous.oewn-02280420-s.tone: Frankness without calculation - the innocence is credited, not mocked.

littered.oewn-02433722-s.tone: Disorder seen as rubbish - the mess condemned, whatever left it.

tousled.oewn-02433993-s.tone: Disorder that flatters - untidiness that can be arranged on purpose.

hugger-mugger.oewn-02434302-s.tone: Archaic and comic - disorder with an air of the furtive about it.

sagacious.oewn-02580114-s.tone: Formal and warm - wisdom shown as insight rather than learning.

sapient.oewn-02580114-s.tone: Latinate and cool - wisdom observed from a distance rather than warmly praised.

sapiential.oewn-02580602-s.tone: Lofty, theological approval - wisdom of the godly kind rather than everyday shrewdness.

speculative.oewn-00668084-s.tone: Curiosity held at a distance - it wonders and weighs rather than asks.

nosey.oewn-00668361-s.tone: The same accusation as 'nosy' - curiosity that has crossed into prying.

atrabilious.oewn-01138769-s.tone: Archaic and ornate - irritability dressed as a bodily ailment, hard to say with a straight face.

bilious.oewn-01138769-s.tone: Makes the temper sound like a symptom - irritability explained by the gut, and slightly mocked for it.

splenetic.oewn-01138920-s.tone: The most literary word for a bad temper - irritability dressed for print.

prickly.oewn-01138920-s.tone: Quick to bristle - the spines are in the metaphor, and handling is at your own risk.

ornery.oewn-01139173-s.tone: American, and it can be said with affection - an ornery mule is being described, not blamed.

choleric.oewn-01139414-s.tone: Anger that arrives fast and is presented as constitutional - temper as temperament.

hot-tempered.oewn-01139414-s.tone: The plain compound - anger as heat, immediate and undisguised.

glad.oewn-01150423-s.tone: Mild - pleasure light enough to be said out of mere politeness.

austere.oewn-01303135-s.tone: Stern without malice - a coldness of bearing rather than of intent.

clamorous.oewn-01926766-s.tone: Offensively loud and insistent - outcry pressed until it is answered.

creaky.oewn-01927734-s.tone: A rasp or grate that suggests age and strain - the sound of something barely holding.

screaky.oewn-01927734-s.tone: The shriller variant, and it sounds like what it means.

base.oewn-02354354-s.tone: Technical of metals - a grading judgement, not a moral one.

tinny.oewn-02354508-s.tone: Cheapness of material - flimsy, as if pressed from thin metal.

cheesy.oewn-02354508-s.tone: Poor quality worn openly - the contempt can carry affection, the badness part of the appeal.

jealous.oewn-02473333-s.tone: Fear of being displaced - suspicion that treats the rival as already real.

green-eyed.oewn-02473333-s.tone: Literary and accusing - jealousy given a face and a colour.

wary.oewn-02473505-s.tone: Distrust worn openly - confidence withheld, and seen to be withheld.

mistrustful.oewn-02473505-s.note: hm resolved: 'a shade more tentative' differentiates the word from 'distrustful' without denying the openness in the gloss

suspicious.oewn-02473505-s.tone: Distrust worn openly - it faults the withholding of trust, not the caution behind it.

aged.oewn-02591485-s.flag: charge -1 to 0: erosion gloss is neutral-technical and the note says so; note kept

attrited.oewn-02591610-s.tone: Dry and technical - wear stated as a process, not a complaint.

battered.oewn-02591692-s.tone: Implies force rather than time - the damage was dealt in blows.
battered.oewn-02591692-s.note: hm resolved: the of-a-person caveat invoked the abuse synset; trimmed to the claim that fits this gloss

derelict.oewn-02591968-s.tone: Worn past repair - hard use has run all the way through it.

run-down.oewn-02591968-s.tone: Worn past shabbiness by hard use - the thing has been driven to exhaustion.

woebegone.oewn-02591968-s.tone: Run-down and wearing it mournfully - the ruin looks as if it grieves for itself.

eared.oewn-02592267-s.tone: The clipped form of 'dog-eared' - shabby from use, and slightly fond about it.

dog-eared.oewn-02592267-s.tone: Nearly affectionate - the wear says the thing was handled, read, even loved.

eroded.oewn-02592502-s.flag: charge -1 to 0: note itself calls the sense neutral; note kept

lately.oewn-00108184-r.reason: gloss is the plain time adverb; the note belongs to late 'deceased'

aptly.oewn-00186658-r.reason: gloss 'with competence' does not match apt 'quick to learn', the sense the note was written for

thankfully.oewn-00201415-r.reason: the trace-of-prayer note belongs to the sentence adverb of relief, not this manner gloss

cantankerously.oewn-00282813-r.reason: adverb gloss 'in a bad mood' diverges from the settled-disposition sense the note describes

dishonestly.oewn-00315990-r.reason: the settled-disposition claim cannot transfer to a manner adverb that condemns single acts

richly.oewn-00359047-r.reason: the faintly-accusing force of rich-the-person does not exist in 'in a rich manner'

clamorously.oewn-00414618-r.reason: adverb gloss 'in manner that attracts attention' is broader than the offensively-loud sense the note fits

preciously.oewn-00431167-r.reason: gloss is the bare intensifier 'very'; the affectation note and charge do not apply

voraciously.oewn-00495930-r.reason: the note is bound to the food gloss; this adverb gloss covers any voracious manner

stubbornly.oewn-00200274-r.tone: Refusal held past the point of reason - the word faults the persistence.

bounteously.oewn-00281297-r.tone: Biblical in flavour - generosity on a grand scale.

selfishly.oewn-00328482-r.tone: The plain moral word - a direct accusation, nothing clinical in it.

high-handedly.oewn-00359172-r.tone: A decision taken over someone's head, with no thought of asking.

benevolently.oewn-00396497-r.tone: Formal and settled - kindness as a disposition rather than a mood.

wholeheartedly.oewn-00497146-r.tone: Devotion offered entire - nothing held back.
